prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Looker/SQL developer
We're looking for a sql/lookml developer who can figure out a schema fairly independently and build relatively complex queries - eg queries using window functions to analyze time series data. * Must be able to work 9 - 11 am PST most days of the week, other time flexible. * Strong SQL * Able to quickly pick up details of complex new domain * Ideally will know BigQuery well, but be able to pick up new sql dialects quickly eg. SQL Server
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience helping teams turn complex data into clear, usable insights. I’d be excited to support your Looker/SQL development needs and help you build reliable queries and reporting that are both accurate and easy to maintain.

I have strong hands-on experience with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. That background has taught me how to move efficiently from raw data to structured analysis, while keeping an eye on accuracy, logic, and clarity. I’m comfortable working with messy or unfamiliar data and can quickly get up to speed on new schemas and business domains.

Your need for someone who can figure out a schema independently and build relatively complex queries is a strong match for how I like to work. I’m comfortable writing SQL for analysis, including queries that use window functions and other techniques for time series and trend analysis. I also understand the importance of adapting quickly to different SQL dialects and am prepared to ramp up fast in environments that use BigQuery or other systems such as SQL Server.

I’m also careful about communication and availability. I can work 9–11 am PST most days of the week, and I’m flexible outside of that window as needed. I value responsiveness, consistency, and staying aligned with the team so the work moves smoothly.

If you’re looking for someone who can combine strong SQL skills with careful analytical thinking, learn new domain details quickly, and contribute with minimal hand-holding, I’d love the opportunity to help. I’m confident I can bring a steady, detail-oriented approach to your Looker/SQL work and be a dependable part of the process.
